info.name: AutoLead API
info.description:
AutoLead backend — used-car brokerage API.

**Auth:** email + password. JWT is identity only; live roles come from `user_roles` on each request.

**Staff routes** require Bearer + Admin role. **Owner routes** require Bearer + Admin or Salesperson (deactivate is Admin-only). **Catalog, Vehicles, Leads, Notifications, Dashboard, Showrooms** accept Admin or Salesperson; lead assignment, vehicle status changes, and media/document deletes are Admin-only. A salesperson only sees leads assigned to them.

Error envelope: `{ "error": { "code": string, "message": string } }`
Pagination: `limit` default 20 max 100; `offset` default 0; page `{ items, total, limit, offset }`.

Flow: Login → create owner → pick catalog variant → create vehicle → create lead → associate vehicle → assign lead → schedule follow-up → change status → inbox.

request.description: GET /health — 200 `{ status, timestamp }`.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Email + password. Login and Refresh are public. Me requires Bearer.

request.description: POST /auth/login — 200 `{ accessToken, refreshToken }`. Invalid credentials → 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS.
POST /auth/refresh — 200 rotated `{ accessToken, refreshToken }`.

Returns the authenticated user's profile and live roles.

**Auth:** Bearer token required.

**200** — Profile returned successfully.

**401** — Missing or invalid token (`AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`).

**404** — Token valid but user record no longer exists (`NOT_FOUND`).

**503** — Database unavailable (`DB_UNAVAILABLE`). Previously caused by an ambiguous PostgREST FK embed on `user_roles → users`; fixed by disambiguating with `users!user_id!inner(deleted_at)`.

response.name: 503 DB Unavailable

item.name: Users
item.description: Admin-only staff CRUD. Roles: admin | salesperson. JWT must belong to an admin in user_roles.

request.description: POST /users — 201. Provisions Auth user (email + password) + profile + staff roles.
GET /users — paginated. Optional `role=admin` or `role=salesperson`.
GET /users/:id — 200 staff member or 404.
PATCH /users/:id — name, phone, email, showroomId. Email is required.
PUT /users/:id/roles — replace set, min 1. Cannot drop the last admin.
DELETE /users/:id — 204 soft-deactivate. Cannot deactivate self or last admin.

item.name: Owners
item.description: Staff owner CRUD. Admin or Salesperson. Deactivate is Admin-only. Phone is the unique live key.

request.description: POST /owners — 201. Duplicate live phone → 409 CONFLICT.

query.description: Partial match on name, phone or city

request.description: GET /owners — paginated. Optional `city` and `phone` filters. Optional search: partial match on name, phone or city.
GET /owners/:id — 200 owner or 404.
PATCH /owners/:id — profile fields. Duplicate live phone → 409.
DELETE /owners/:id — 204 soft-deactivate. Admin only.
GET /catalog/makes — paginated makes. Admin or Salesperson.
GET /catalog/makes/:makeId/models — Admin.
GET /catalog/models/:modelId/variants — includes factory fuel, transmission, ex-showroom price.
POST /vehicles — Admin or Salesperson. `showroomId` is optional: it defaults to your home showroom, and only admins may name another. Duplicate live registration → 409.

GET /vehicles — filters: status, ownerId, showroomId, registration. Each item carries `frontImageUrl` / `frontImageUrlExpiresAt` (signed URL of the lowest-sortOrder `front` photo, ~10 min; both null when there is none) for list thumbnails. Optional: search, makeId, modelId, variantId, yearMin/yearMax, kmMin/kmMax, fuelType and transmission (comma-separated). Items carry linkedLeadCount.
GET /vehicles/:id — catalog names and `frontImageUrl` / `frontImageUrlExpiresAt` included.
PATCH /vehicles/:id — second-hand details only.

POST /vehicles/:id/status (Admin) — 200 `{ status, unlinkedLeadCount }`. Only `dropped` and `open` (re-list) are accepted; `linked` / `sold` follow the vehicle's leads → 422 VEHICLE_STATUS_SYSTEM_MANAGED. Graph: open ⇄ linked (auto), linked → sold (auto, lead converts), open/linked → dropped, dropped → open. Dropping a vehicle with active leads → 422 VEHICLE_HAS_LINKED_LEADS with `error.details.linkedLeadCount`; resend with `confirmUnlinkLeads: true` to unlink those leads and drop it.
GET /vehicles/:id/status-history — newest first. Each item has `changedBy` (user id) and `changedByName` (that user's full name).
POST /vehicles/:id/media/uploads — then PUT bytes to uploadUrl.
POST /vehicles/:id/media — object must already exist in storage.
GET /vehicles/:id/media — includes short-lived signed read URLs.
DELETE /vehicles/:id/media/:mediaId (Admin) — 204.
POST /vehicles/:id/documents/uploads — then PUT bytes to uploadUrl.
POST /vehicles/:id/documents — object must already exist in storage. Optional `fileName` (display name; folder part dropped, 1–255 chars) is stored and returned as `fileName`.
GET /vehicles/:id/documents — signed read URLs only; always sensitive. `fileName` is the uploader's original name, or null for older uploads (fall back to docType).
DELETE /vehicles/:id/documents/:documentId (Admin) — 204.

request.description: POST /leads — walk-in contact by phone. Admin or Salesperson; a salesperson's lead is assigned to them. `showroomId` is optional. Optional catalog preference `preferredMakeId` / `preferredModelId` / `preferredVariantId` (send only the narrowest; parents are filled in; mismatched parents → 422 PREFERRED_CATALOG_MISMATCH; unknown id → 404). Optional preference profile (empty = any): `preferredColours[]` (free text), `preferredFuelTypes[]` (petrol|diesel|cng|electric|hybrid), `preferredTransmissions[]` (manual|automatic|amt|cvt|dct), `preferredBodyTypes[]` (hatchback|sedan|suv|muv|mpv|crossover|coupe|convertible|sports|pick-up), `preferredYearMin` / `preferredYearMax`, `preferredKmMax`, `preferredMaxOwners`; `budget` is the price ceiling. Invalid values → 422 VALIDATION_ERROR.

GET /leads — filters (all optional, AND-combined): status, vehicleId, assignedTo (admin only), preferredMakeId, preferredModelId, preferredVariantId, search (contact name/phone, partial), budgetMin, budgetMax, source (comma-separated), hasVehicle (true|false), purchaseTimeline, financeRequired (true|false), createdFrom (inclusive), createdTo (exclusive). A salesperson only sees leads assigned to them. Items include `assignedToName`, `linkedVehicle` ({ id, makeName, modelName, variantName, year, registrationNumber } or null) and the preferred catalog ids + names.

**Story:** On a car's detail screen, staff see how well each linked lead's preference fits the car, plus open leads worth calling about it.

GET /leads/vehicle-matches/:vehicleId — Admin or Salesperson (a salesperson only gets leads assigned to them).

- `minScore` (optional int 0–100, default 60): lowest score for a suggestion.
- `limit` (optional int 1–50, default 10): most suggestions.

200 `{ vehicle, linked, suggested, truncated }`:
- `vehicle`: the car's matchable attributes (make/model/variant ids + names, year, kmDriven, colour, fuelType, transmission, bodyTypes, numPreviousOwners, listedPrice or null).
- `linked`: every lead linked to the car, best match first; each is the lead object plus `match: { score, evaluatedCriteria, breakdown[] } | null` (null = no preference).
- `suggested`: open (`new` / `not_now` / `vehicle_unavailable`), unlinked leads in the car's showroom scoring ≥ minScore on ≥ 2 criteria.
- `truncated`: only the newest 1000 open leads were scored.
- breakdown item: `criterion` (catalog|budget|year|km|fuelType|transmission|bodyType|previousOwners|colour), `weight`, `earned`, `outcome` (match|partial|miss|unknown).

Errors: 404 unknown car; 422 VALIDATION_ERROR on bad query; 403 non-staff.
GET /leads/:id — includes next follow-up, `linkedVehicle` summary, and preferred catalog ids + names.

PATCH /leads/:id (Admin, or the assigned Salesperson) — 200 lead. Full replace of fullName, phone, email, source, budget, purchaseTimeline, financeRequired, currentVehicle, tradeInRequired, notes (omitted optional fields are cleared). A new phone moves the lead to that phone's contact. Closed lead → 422 LEAD_CLOSED. Embeds (linkedVehicle, names) are null in the response; GET for them.

request.description: PUT /leads/:id/assignment (Admin) — 200 `{ id, assignedTo }`. assignedTo must be an active admin or salesperson, or null to unassign. Notifies the assignee (`lead_assigned`). Closed lead → 422 LEAD_CLOSED.

PUT /leads/:id/preference (Admin, or the assigned Salesperson) — 200 with the whole preference (`preferredMakeId` … `preferredMaxOwners`). Full replace: every field you omit is cleared, so send the whole form; an empty body clears it. Catalog: send only the narrowest id and the server fills in its parents (mismatch → 422 PREFERRED_CATALOG_MISMATCH; unknown/deleted id → 404). Profile fields: `preferredColours[]`, `preferredFuelTypes[]` (petrol|diesel|cng|electric|hybrid), `preferredTransmissions[]` (manual|automatic|amt|cvt|dct), `preferredBodyTypes[]` (hatchback|sedan|suv|muv|mpv|crossover|coupe|convertible|sports|pick-up), `preferredYearMin`/`preferredYearMax` (1950–2100, min ≤ max), `preferredKmMax` (≥ 0), `preferredMaxOwners` (≥ 0); invalid → 422 VALIDATION_ERROR. Budget (the price ceiling) is edited with PATCH /leads/:id. Closed lead → 422 LEAD_CLOSED.
PATCH /leads/:id/vehicle — attach a live vehicle.

DELETE /leads/:id/vehicle (Admin, or the assigned Salesperson) — 200 `{ vehicleId: null }`. Clears the link; the vehicle goes back to open when no other active lead holds it. Closed lead → 422 LEAD_CLOSED; booking_confirmed → 422 LEAD_REQUIRES_VEHICLE.
POST /leads/:id/follow-ups — assigned to the lead's assignee (or you if unassigned), who gets the due notification.

POST /leads/:id/status — 200 `{ status, vehicleSold }`. new → not_now | booking_confirmed | lost; not_now → new | booking_confirmed | lost; booking_confirmed → converted | lost; vehicle_unavailable → new | not_now | booking_confirmed | lost. booking_confirmed/converted need a vehicle (422 LEAD_REQUIRES_VEHICLE); vehicle_unavailable is system-only. Invalid transition → 422.
GET /leads/:id/status-history — 200 page, newest first, of { id, leadId, fromStatus, toStatus, changedBy, changedByName, notes, changedAt }. Same visibility as GET /leads/:id.

POST /leads/:id/status from booking_confirmed — sells the lead's vehicle to this lead (vehicle `soldLeadId`) and moves every other active lead on that vehicle to vehicle_unavailable (vehicle unlinked). Safe to repeat if it fails part-way.

GET /notifications — the caller's inbox (Admin or Salesperson): `lead_assigned` right away, `follow_up_due` at the scheduled time. Optional isRead=true|false. Response adds unreadCount (unread due items, whatever the filter); items carry leadId.
PATCH /notifications/:id/read — 204. Own notifications only.

query.description: Optional showroom UUID; omit for all showrooms

request.description: GET /dashboard — Admin or Salesperson. Period-to-date KPIs with `previous` (same elapsed span of the prior period), attention lists (overdue follow-ups, active leads without a follow-up, aged stock > 45 days), today's follow-ups, pipeline and inventory. Lists hold up to 5 rows plus `total`. Invalid `period` → 422. See docs/api.md#dashboard--admin-or-salesperson. Admin: scope 'all'. Salesperson: scope 'mine' (own leads), with kpis.inStock, attention.agedStock and inventory null.

response.name: 200 Dashboard

query.description: Optional showroom UUID; omit for all showrooms

request.description: GET /showrooms (Admin or Salesperson) — 200 page of { id, name, city }, active showrooms by name.
